row:
Follow along as we save equines in need! We show the journeys of horses rescued from unfavorable circumstances, the retraining process and how we rehabilitate the mind and body. 

RH Farm Rescue is a registered 501 (c)(3) Nonprofit charity dedicated to the rescue, care and rehabilitation of abused, neglected and at-risk horses. We accept surrenders, pull from auction and other avenues of rescue. We work very hard to find them a forever home, and a better future. 

We are always in need of financial help, we care for these horses as long as they need us and our donors support this vital mission. With your donation we can save more horses from slaughter, rehabilitate neglected ponies and help equines in need find the love they deserve. 

To Donate: https://donorbox.org/rhfarmrescue
https://rh-farm.com/donations
